title: OpenTelemetry dashboards for desktop Code tab sessions go empty after 2.1.332 because service.name changed
symptoms: Filters on service.name = claude-code show no desktop sessions
Desktop Code tab telemetry appears under a new service name claude-code-desktop
cause: 2.1.332 changed the default service.name for desktop Code tab sessions from claude-code to claude-code-desktop.
fix: Update queries and alerts to the new name, or set OTEL_SERVICE_NAME to keep the old value.
affected: Desktop Code tab sessions on Claude Code 2.1.332 and later
